accessibility.info:
* Wheelchair accessible patrons may purchase up to 3 companion seats with each wheelchair accessible space. Please note that the mezzanine and balcony, while they can be reached via elevator, have stairs and are not accessible for wheelchair transfers.

* Limited mobility patrons may purchase limited mobility seating. Boston Opera House has an elevator which can access all levels of the theater. There are no railings on any seating aisles. The mezzanine and balcony have stairs and are not accessible for mobility impairments.

* Sight-impaired and deaf patrons may purchase sight-/hearing-impaired seating.

* Hearing-impaired patrons may purchase sight-/hearing-impaired seating, but may also be accomodated by purchasing regular availability seating and obtaining hearing-impaired devices which can be accessed at coat check upon entry. There is no charge and no need to reserve in advance; ID is required for use. We also offer ASL/OC performances, please contact 617-880-2419 for info.

events.name: The Sports Museum Tour
events.description:
The Sports Museum consists of a half-mile of exhibits at the TD Garden, the home of the Boston Bruins and Boston Celtics.
During your visit to The Sports Museum Tour, our Museum Assistants will guide you through The Sports Museum, which is located primarily on the Premium Levels 5 & 6 of TD Garden. Here you will see the treasures that we have on display evidencing the rich heritage of Boston sports and the influence of sports on the social history and evolution of Boston.

generalInfo.generalRule: Alcohol Policy : To purchase alcoholic beverages, a patron must present a valid MA driver's license, MA liquor ID, passport or military ID, which indicates the patron to be a least 21 years of age (MA ID cards, duplicate licenses, expired licenses, damaged licenses and driver's licenses, which do not have photos, will not be accepted). Out of state licenses are acceptable only if the patron is at least 25 years of age and another form of identification (e.g., credit card) will be required if the patron is between 25 and 30 years of age. For out of country patrons, only a valid Passport will be accepted as proof of identification. No smoking is allowed in the building.
generalInfo.childRule: Children under 2 free on adults lap for all events, Celtics, Bruins, family shows, and concerts. Some exceptions may apply.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Brighton Music Hall Box Office is open for ticket purchases from 12 PM to 6 PM, Monday through Friday. On show nights, the Box Office will remain open until approximately 15-30 mins after the headliner takes the stage. If traveling from out of town, please call the customer line at 617-562-8801 to verify hours.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: We accept Cash (American currency only), American Express, Discover, Visa, and Mastercard. Apple/Google/Samsung Pay is also accepted. We are unable to accept checks.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: All tickets sold for Brighton Music Hall are delivered digitally, unless otherwise denoted. Tickets sold in person will be delivered via telephone number or email address. Will call is available only on the night of the show. A valid photo I.D. is required for ticket pickup. Note: Artist will call is typically not available until around 1 hour prior to doors, but times vary per event.

venues.parkingDetail: You may only purchase a $30 parking voucher for the parking lot located at 181 Brighton Ave if you also purchase a ticket for the corresponding nights show at Brighton Music Hall. A parking attendant will scan your digital parking voucher. You will not be admitted to the lot if you do not provide a valid voucher. You may park your vehicle in a spot at the far left side of the lot as directed by the parking attendant from 1 hour before the show until 1 hour after the Brighton Music Hall show ends or 2:30am, whichever comes first. YOUR VEHICLE IS SUBJECT TO TOWING OUTSIDE OF THESE TIMES. Neither Brighton Music Hall nor Hallston Realty Associates are responsible, and neither assumes liability for any loss or damage to your vehicle or items left in your vehicle, whether resulting from fire, theft or other cause. Tailgating is not permitted on the lot.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: We have an area stage left set up for an unobstructed view. Patrons in need of this space should purchase a general admission ticket and contact the venue to make arrangements. Please contact us by calling 617-562-8800 or emailing information@crossroadspresents.com. Sign language interpreters and assistive listening devices must be requested in advance. Last-minute sign language interpreter requests are subject to interpreter availability. Service Animals are also allowed.

generalInfo.generalRule: Brighton Music Hall does not have a specific bag policy. ALL ITEMS ARE SUBJECT TO SEARCH. Re-entry is allowed with the appropriate stamp as smoking inside the club is strictly prohibited. See staff at the door before stepping outside. Guests, including law enforcement personnel not present in an official capacity, are prohibited from bringing weapons into the venue. For a full list of prohibited items, please visit the Crossroads Presents official website.
generalInfo.childRule: Patrons under the age of 18 wishing to attend an 18+ show may do so as long as they are accompanied by a parent or guardian. All guests over the age of one year old require a ticket.

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: 617-960-8315 to get information on upcoming shows or help with accessible seating.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Citizens House of Blues box office opens 1 (one) hour prior to doors opening on show days and will close approximately 10-15 minutes after the headliner takes the stage.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cash - American Currency Only Credit Cards - Mastercard, Visa, Discover, American Express. Credit cards must be accompanied by a photo ID (license or passport). We do not accept Apple Pay.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call opens at the box office 1 hour prior to door time. Customers must bring their valid photo ID, confirmation number, and credit card that was used for purchase to pick up tickets. Names on ID must match the credit card used. You may not pick up tickets for someone else.

venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Citizens House of Blues is wheelchair accessible. Please note that it is unlawful for anyone, other than those with a disability or that guests companion, to use tickets for accessible seating locations (unless seats have been released for general seating). **Its encouraged that guests who require accessible accommodation arrive 30 minutes prior to doors opening.** Please call the box office or email: information@crossroadspresents.com to have your name added to the accessibility list for the show you are attending. You must have purchased a ticket for the show in advance.

generalInfo.generalRule: No bottles, cans, outside food or beverages (including alcohol), any item that can be used as a weapon. No dress code for concerts. Camera policy: personal cameras are allowed. Flash photography, video, and removable lens cameras are not permitted without venue approval. Bags must not exceed the maximum size of 12" x6" x12". All bags, regardless of size, are subject to search by security. Lighters are not allowed in the venue and there is absolutely NO SMOKING OR VAPING allowed per the city of Boston Ordinances. Any smoking or vaping will result in IMMEDIATE EJECTION from the event. Any medication must be accompanied by proof of prescription. This list of prohibited items is subject to change at the discretion of venue management. For more information, https://www.houseofblues.com/boston/faq ALL SALES ARE FINAL. NO REFUNDS OR EXCHANGES.
generalInfo.childRule: All ages are welcome unless otherwise stated on ticket or website listing. No discounts. Everyone needs a ticket for entry.

ada.adaCustomCopy:
Citizens House of Blues Boston is primarily a general admission, standing room only venue with seating on the 3rd floor.
For guests with ADA accessible needs, purchase the appropriate number of wheelchair/mobility impaired/companion tickets required for your party.
Please plan on arriving at House of Blues approximately 20 minutes before the door time to the main entrance at 15 Lansdowne St. Your party will be
Accommodated in our ADA accessible area. If you have additional questions, please contact the venue directly at 1-888-693-2583.
